{{Short description|Genus of flowering plants}} {{Hatnote|This article covers the plant genus. For the gastropod genus, see [[Canistrum (gastropod)]].}} {{Automatic taxobox |image = Canistrum seidelianum 20090526.jpg |taxon = Canistrum |authority = [[Charles Jacques Édouard Morren|E.Morren]] |synonyms_ref = |synonyms = *''Mosenia'' Lindm. *''Wittrockia'' Lindm. *''Edmundoa'' Leme }} '''''Canistrum''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Bromeliaceae]], subfamily [[Bromelioideae]]. The genus names are from the Greek “kanistron” (a kind of basket carried on the head). This [[bromeliad]] genus is [[endemic]] to the [[Atlantic Forest|Atlantic Forest biome]] (''Mata Atlantica Brasileira''), located in southeastern [[Brazil]].[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=223793 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families][http://www.dpi.inpe.br/referata/arq/22_Rafael_Bromelias/Bromelia_Mata_Atlantica.pdf DPI.inpe.br: "BROMELIACEAE da MATA ATLÂNTICA BRASILEIRA: Lista de ESPÉCIES, DISTRIBUIÇÃO e CONSERVAÇÃO"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706160944/http://www.dpi.inpe.br/referata/arq/22_Rafael_Bromelias/Bromelia_Mata_Atlantica.pdf |date=2011-07-06 }}; ''Rodriguésia 59'', February 2008; ppg 209−258; article−{{in lang|pt}}, abstract−{{in lang|en}}, species lists−{{in lang|la}}. accessed 30 May 2016.Fragments of the Atlantic Forest of Northeast Brazil: Biodiversity, Conservation and the Bromeliads by Jose Alves Siqueira Filho & Elton M.C.
